## Guild Bank
Lets a player export bags, bank, mail attachments to a bbcode
![guildbank-bbcode](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/109839/39319283-511eff10-4989-11e8-88a7-7099e229fe9d.png)
 or discord (plain) formatted list for posting.
![guildbank-discord](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/109839/44212361-d0ba9580-a173-11e8-9a65-97677d9686fb.png)

### Configuration / Usage
- FuBar or Minimap plugin for setting options.  
- Click icon to show export frame.  
- `/gbank` or `/guildbank` command-line if minimap icon is hidden.

### Features
Filters Bind on Pickup and equipped items automatically.  

### Install
Download the guildbank-x-y.zip file from Assets and extract in AddOns.  
Recommended to remove previous addon folder entirely if upgrading from a v1.0
